title: Independent fleet views
summary: Read-only selected-physics coast evaluation with per-view caches.

blocks.text: view.fleet@1.0.0 creates one read-only fleet builder per view. Supply WorldRead, presentation time/alpha, camera/viewport, pilot identity, previous state, display-frame adapters and names. It never steps a world. Sleeping coasts use the selected context orbital provider and guarded coastAt, preserving custom compatible model identities instead of consulting the default global kernel.

Each instance owns its position/label caches and counters; world replacement clears them. Distinct guest instances use their own pilot identity for foreign labels. Conservative annulus/screen culling and bounded sub-pixel position reuse preserve original defaults; marginPixels and stillPixels configure viewer cost only. Dispose drops retained world/cache references and rejects future builds. No renderer, device or DOM dependency; browser/offline/node are supported.
